fusions.name: Drizzle Spit
fusions.desc: Spits a jet of water that deals 3 damage and has a 30% chance of leaving the target [Soaked] for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Flash Flood
fusions.desc: Floods the ground around you, dealing 30 damage to every enemy within 3.5 tiles and giving each a 60% chance of [Soaked] for 8 seconds. The blow ignores resistances.

fusions.name: Washed Clean
fusions.desc: Restores 16 health to you and every ally within 4 tiles.

fusions.name: Cold Soak
fusions.desc: Each time you are hurt by anything other than fire, you regain 3 health a second for 5 seconds. Once every 10 seconds.
